faq.headline: Built to earn your trust before it asks for it.

items.question: Is Ritora a medical product?
items.answer: No. Ritora helps you make safer daily routine choices with the products you already own. It does not diagnose, treat, or replace a dermatologist.

items.question: Do I need to buy new products to use it well?
items.answer: Not at all. Ritora starts with your shelf. It helps you get more out of the products you already own before it suggests anything new.

items.question: Will it work for beginners?
items.answer: Yes. Beginners and collectors overwhelmed by their own shelf are exactly who Ritora is built for. It's a simpler path to a routine that actually works.

items.question: Do I need to upload photos?
items.answer: No. The Skin Journal is optional. Routines, ingredient checks, and Smart Picks all work without a single photo. Uploading just makes the guidance more adaptive.

items.question: Is the community public? Do I have to share?
items.answer: Sharing is opt-in. Your shelf and Skin Journal stay private by default. Only the playbooks and reviews you choose to publish go to the community, and you can withdraw any of them at any time.

items.question: Is it free?
items.answer: Yes, the core experience is free. No card required to sign up. Optional paid tiers may arrive later for advanced features, but the 'stop buying, start using' experience stays free.

items.question: How is my data handled?
items.answer: With care. Ritora runs on explicit consent, careful data boundaries, and secure authentication. Privacy-conscious handling is built in from day one. See the data flow above.

items.question: Which languages are supported?
items.answer: English, Swedish, and Spanish at launch. You can change your preferred language any time from settings.

sunPigment.pageDesc: Sun reaction matters more than skin tone. It shapes which actives are safe for you.
sunPigment.questionPhototype: After a full day outside, your skin usually:
sunPigment.whyPhototype: Phototype is the standard way clinicians describe sun reaction. It guides how aggressively Ritora can suggest actives.
sunPigment.questionPih: After a pimple heals, do dark marks linger?
sunPigment.whyPih: Post-inflammatory hyperpigmentation makes irritation cost more. Ritora will pick gentler actives and emphasise sunscreen.
sunPigment.questionMelasma: Do you experience melasma or persistent dark patches?
sunPigment.whyMelasma: Melasma needs special handling. Ritora will avoid heat-triggering actives and lean on tinted sunscreens.
sunPigment.questionKeloid: Does your skin scar with raised marks (keloids)?
sunPigment.whyKeloid: Keloid-prone skin needs gentler exfoliation choices.
sunPigment.questionSunscreen: How often do you wear sunscreen?
sunPigment.whySunscreen: Daily sunscreen use lowers irritation risk and slows photoaging.
sunPigment.questionTolerance: How do most sunscreens feel on your skin?
sunPigment.whyTolerance: If sunscreens irritate you, Ritora will favour mineral filters and tinted finishes.
sunPigment.questionFilter: Which sunscreen filter do you prefer?
sunPigment.whyFilter: Mineral, chemical, and hybrid filters feel different on skin. Ritora will respect your preference.
sunPigment.questionFinish: Which sunscreen finish do you prefer?
sunPigment.whyFinish: Adherence is higher when textures match your preference.

lifestyle.questionSleep: How much sleep do you get on average?
lifestyle.whySleep: Less than 6 hours raises cortisol and oil production. Ritora will note this in suggestions.
lifestyle.whyStress: Stress drives cortisol-related breakouts. Ritora will favour calming actives if stress is high.
lifestyle.questionWater: How much water do you drink daily?
lifestyle.whyWater: Hydration helps barrier function. Low intake may explain dehydrated skin.
lifestyle.questionDiet: Any of these in your diet often?
lifestyle.whyDiet: High sugar and dairy correlate with acne for some people. Ritora won't lecture, but will surface lifestyle hints.
lifestyle.whySmoking: Smoking accelerates skin aging. Ritora will weight antioxidants higher.
lifestyle.questionAlcohol: How often do you drink alcohol?
lifestyle.whyAlcohol: Alcohol dehydrates the skin. Ritora may suggest extra hydration steps.
lifestyle.questionSweat: Do you sweat a lot during exercise?
lifestyle.whySweat: Sweat-prone skin needs different cleansing strategies.
lifestyle.questionMask: Do you wear a mask often (e.g. work)?
lifestyle.whyMask: Mask wear can trigger maskne. Ritora will avoid heavy occlusives in mask zones.
lifestyle.whyShaving: Shaving affects barrier and exfoliation tolerance.
lifestyle.questionClimate: Which environmental conditions bother your skin?
lifestyle.whyClimate: Ritora will tailor occlusives and barrier care to your climate sensitivities.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy

overview.title: Overview
overview.lead: Ritora helps you build a calmer, safer skincare routine. To do that we ask for a few things: a little about your skin, the products you use, and the way your skin reacts over time. We try to ask for as little as possible, and we tell you exactly what we do with what you give us.
overview.intro: Three things to know up front.
bullets: We do not sell your information.
We do not train AI models on your photos or your skin profile.
You can delete your account, and everything in it, from inside the app whenever you want.
overview.tail: If anything on this page is unclear, write to <support>{supportEmail}</support> and a human will reply.

whatWeCollect.title: What we collect
whatWeCollect.lead: We collect four kinds of information, and only when you give it to us or when it is needed to make the app work.
whatWeCollect.accountInfo: Account information. When you create an account we ask for your email address and a password. We never see your password in plain text. We store it as a one way cryptographic hash, which means even we cannot read it. You can also tell us your name, language, time zone, date of birth, and sex at birth. The last two are optional and help us give you better skincare suggestions.
whatWeCollect.skinProfile: Skin profile. During onboarding we ask you about your skin. Your skin type, the concerns you have, allergies and past reactions, medications, sun and sleep habits, and the kinds of products you prefer. You can change or remove any answer at any time.
whatWeCollect.photosAndRoutine: Photos and routine activity. If you use the skin journal we keep the photos you upload, the dates they were taken, and the notes the AI generates from them. We also store the products you add to your shelf, the routine you build, and the records of what you actually applied each day.
whatWeCollect.basicTech: Basic technical information. Standard server logs. Your IP address, browser, request times, and any errors. Plus your notification preferences.
whatWeCollect.tail: We do not collect your precise location. We do not use advertising trackers. There are no marketing cookies in the product.

howWeUse.title: How we use it
howWeUse.lead: We use what you give us to do these things, and only these things.
bullets: Run your account and keep you signed in.
Generate the daily routine that fits your skin.
Analyse your skin journal and flag possible reactions early.
Send the emails you would expect from us: verification, password reset, and any notifications you turn on.
Keep the service safe, fix bugs, and prevent abuse.
Meet our legal obligations.
howWeUse.tail: That is the whole list. No advertising. No selling. No quiet resale to anyone else. If we ever want to use your information for something new, we will ask you first.

photosAndAi.title: Photos and AI
photosAndAi.lead: The skin journal helps you see how your skin changes. Here is how it works behind the scenes.
bullets: Photos are sent to a third party AI provider for analysis. The provider is contractually bound not to keep them and not to train any model on them.
We strip GPS information from your photos before storing them.
We do not run facial recognition. We do not build a face template. The analysis looks at the skin, not at the person.
photosAndAi.bulletStrong: We do not use your photos or skin profile to train any AI model. Not ours. Not anyone else's.
photosAndAi.disclaimer: Ritora gives you suggestions. It is not medical advice. If your skin is reacting, please see a dermatologist or a pharmacist. You can override or skip any suggestion the app gives you.

sharing.title: Sharing your data
sharing.p1: We do not sell your information. We do not share it with advertisers. There is no version of Ritora that funds itself by selling its users.
sharing.p2: The only time your information leaves our systems is when the law obliges us to share it, or when you ask us to. If Ritora is ever acquired or merges with another company, you will be told before anything moves, and this policy will still apply.

retention.title: How long we keep it
retention.p1: We keep your information for as long as your account is active. When you delete your account, we keep your data for 30 days in case you change your mind, and then we erase it from our systems.
retention.p2: A couple of specific timelines. Photos in the skin journal are removed within seven days of you deleting them. Server logs roll over within 90 days. Where the law obliges us to keep a record (for example, accounting), we keep only the minimum that is required for the time it is required.

location.title: Where your data lives
location.p1: Your information is stored in the European Union. Some AI processing happens in the United States under the standard legal safeguards that European law requires. Your data is encrypted in transit and at rest.

security.title: Security
security.p1: We treat security as part of the product, not as an afterthought.
security.p2: Your data is encrypted in transit and at rest. The sensitive fields in your skin profile get an extra layer of encryption before they touch the database.
security.p3: No system is perfectly secure. If anything ever goes wrong, we will tell you. If you find a problem, please write to <support>{supportEmail}</support>.

rights.title: Your rights and choices
rights.lead: You stay in control of your information. From Settings inside the app you can:
bullets: Download a copy of everything we have on you.
Edit or remove any part of your skin profile.
Delete a single journal entry, or all of them.
Turn off optional AI features.
Delete your account entirely.
rights.p1: If you would rather do any of this by email, write to <support>{supportEmail}</support>. We respond within a month, usually much sooner, and we do not charge for it.
rights.p2: If you live in the European Union or the United Kingdom, you also have the right to lodge a complaint with your local data protection authority. We hope you would tell us first so we can fix it, but that right is yours either way.

children.title: Children
children.p1: Ritora is for people aged 16 and over. We do not knowingly collect information from anyone younger. If you think a child has signed up, write to <support>{supportEmail}</support> and we will remove the account.

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.lead: We use a small set of cookies, all for basic functionality.
bullets: A session cookie that keeps you signed in.
A cookie that remembers your choices in the cookie banner.
Local storage for your theme and language preferences.
cookies.tail: That is the whole list. No advertising cookies. No fingerprinting. No tracking across other sites.

changes.title: Changes to this policy
changes.p1: If we change anything important on this page, we will update the date at the top, tell you inside the app, and email you when the change is significant. We will do this before the change takes effect, not after.

contact.title: Contact us
contact.p1: For anything about this policy, or about your information, write to <support>{supportEmail}</support>. We read every message.

terms.title: Terms of Service

overview.title: Overview
overview.p1: These are the terms you agree to when you use Ritora. Ritora is an app that helps you build a calmer skincare routine using the products you already own. By creating an account or using the app, you agree to these terms. If you do not agree, please do not use Ritora.

eligibility.title: Eligibility
eligibility.p1: You need to be 16 or over to use Ritora. You also need to give us accurate information about yourself. If we find out you lied, or that you are under 16, we will close the account.

account.title: Your account
account.p1: You are responsible for keeping your password safe and for everything that happens on your account. If you think someone else has got in, tell us straight away at <support>{supportEmail}</support>.

ritoraIs.title: What Ritora is, and what it is not
ritoraIs.p1: Ritora is a decision support tool for your skincare routine. It is not a medical device, not a doctor, and not a diagnosis. The suggestions you get inside the app are help, not advice.
ritoraIs.p2: If your skin is reacting badly, please see a dermatologist or a pharmacist. Anything Ritora tells you, you can change, ignore, or override.

yourContent.title: Your content
yourContent.p1: The photos you upload, the answers you give about your skin, and the routine you build are yours. You keep ownership of them.
yourContent.p2: You give Ritora the limited permission it needs to store your content, process it, and show it back to you in the app. That permission ends when you delete the content or close your account.

prohibited.title: What you cannot do
prohibited.lead: A few things you must not do when using Ritora.
bullets: Pretend to be someone else, or create an account on behalf of someone else without their permission.
Try to scrape, copy, or republish other users' content.
Try to break into the app, reverse engineer it, or test it for vulnerabilities without our written permission.
Use the app for anything illegal, for anything that targets a specific person, or for anything that exposes a minor to content that is not for them.
Post content that harasses, threatens, or harms another person, or that promotes illegal activity.
Resell or rent out access to the app.
prohibited.tail: If you do any of these things we may suspend or close your account without notice.

pricing.title: Pricing
pricing.p1: Ritora is free to use today. If we ever add a paid plan we will tell you before it affects you, and we will not turn off anything you already rely on without giving you fair notice.

suspension.title: Suspension and closing the account
suspension.p1: You can delete your account from inside the app whenever you want. After a 30 day grace period in case you change your mind, everything goes.
suspension.p2: We may suspend or close your account if you break these terms, if we believe you are abusing the service, or if the law requires it. Where we can, we will tell you why.

warranty.title: No warranty
warranty.p1: We work hard to make Ritora useful, but we cannot promise it will always work, always be available, or always be free of bugs. The app is provided as it is. That is the same deal you get from most online services.

liability.title: Limit of our responsibility
liability.p1: To the maximum extent allowed by law, we are not responsible for indirect or consequential losses, lost data, lost profits, or anything that happens to your skin because of a Ritora suggestion. Use your own judgement, and ask a real doctor when you are worried.
liability.p2: If we are held responsible for something despite the rest of this section, our total liability is capped at the amount you paid us in the twelve months before the problem arose. Today that amount is zero.

changes.title: Changes to these terms
changes.p1: If we change these terms in a significant way, we will update the date at the top and tell you inside the app or by email before the change takes effect. By continuing to use Ritora after that, you accept the new version.

factors.recentApplicationChange: A relevant routine step was skipped or swapped recently, which can be a possible contributor if the pattern repeats.
factors.photoQualityContext: Photo quality is usable but not perfect, so Ritora should not guess exact causes from faint detail.
factors.breakoutTiming: Common breakout contributors include clogged pores, sweat or friction, stress, hormonal timing, some foods, and some medications.
factors.slowPigmentTiming: Dark marks often follow inflammation from breakouts, shaving, or irritation, and UV exposure can make them linger.
factors.oilPoreVisibility: Pores can look more visible when oil, heavier products, sweat, or lighting create more shine.
factors.barrierTiming: Barrier stress can follow recent actives, over-cleansing, harsh exfoliation, fragrance, weather shifts, or irritants.
factors.visualTracking: If no clear logged trigger stands out, compare routine, sleep, stress, product, and exposure changes across repeated entries.
factors.acneCommonContributors: Common acne contributors include pore-clogging products, sweat or friction, stress, hormonal timing, some foods, and some medications.
factors.pigmentCommonContributors: Common contributors include sun exposure, irritation, and inflammation after breakouts, shaving, or picking.
factors.oilPoreCommonContributors: Oil production, heavier products, sweat, and clogged pores can make pores or shine more visible.
factors.barrierCommonContributors: Recent actives, over-exfoliation, harsh cleansing, fragrance, weather shifts, or known irritants can contribute to dryness, redness, or barrier stress.
factors.appearanceCommonContributors: Sleep, dryness, dehydration, shadows, and recent product changes can affect texture, fine lines, or under-eye appearance.
factors.generalCommonContributors: Recent product, routine, environment, sleep, stress, or exposure changes can contribute to visible skin changes.

actions.acneSteadyRoutine: Keep the routine steady long enough to see a pattern.
actions.logClusters: Log new, painful, or clustered breakouts so Ritora can compare timing.
actions.spfContext: Log SPF and sun exposure when tracking marks or tone.
actions.preventIrritation: Prioritize preventing irritation because inflammation can keep marks looking darker.
actions.sameLight: Use similar daylight and angle for the next photo.
actions.gentleCleanse: Use gentle cleansing and watch whether shine returns quickly.
actions.oilFreeWhenPossible: Choose lightweight or oil-free textures when they suit your skin.
actions.watchShinePattern: Compare shine patterns before and after routine steps.
actions.simplifyRoutine: Keep the routine simple while the skin looks reactive or uncomfortable.
actions.moisturizerSupport: Support comfort with a plain moisturizer step if it fits your routine.
actions.watchComfort: Let comfort, stinging, tightness, and flaking guide whether to slow down.
actions.watchPattern: Watch the pattern over multiple entries before making a big change.

avoid.multipleNewActives: Adding multiple new actives at once.
avoid.picking: Picking or squeezing spots, because it can worsen inflammation and marks.
avoid.dietPatternIfLogged: Repeating a logged dairy, sugary, or late-night eating pattern if it keeps matching breakout days.
avoid.sweatFrictionAfterExercise: Letting sweat, heat, or friction sit on breakout-prone areas after exercise.
avoid.poreCloggingProducts: Heavy or pore-clogging products on areas that are breaking out.
avoid.inconsistentSpf: Unprotected sun exposure or inconsistent SPF while tracking marks or uneven tone.
avoid.dailyJudgement: Judging pigment progress from one day.
avoid.strippingSkin: Stripping the skin to remove oil.
avoid.overExfoliation: Exfoliating more because pores look visible today.
avoid.addingActives: Adding new actives while the skin looks stressed.
avoid.fragranceIfSensitive: Fragranced products if sensitivity is high.
avoid.knownIrritantReexposure: Repeating a product or routine step that recently lined up with irritation.
avoid.overReadingOnePhoto: Over-reading one photo without repeated context.
